caption: IN THE MATTER OF DISBARMENT OF MARTIN BARNETT REINER
text: Martin Barnett Reiner, of Beverly Hills, California, having been suspended from the practice of law in this Court by order of October 29, 2018; and a rule having been issued and served upon him requiring him to show cause why he should not be disbarred; and a response having been filed; It is ordered that Martin Barnett Reiner is disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.
